identity.name: Dawnbringer
identity.description: Each affordable normal melee activation costs 3 stamina; damage targets the current enemy. Piercing bypasses that amount of enemy block. Ordinary attacks activate once per round; explicit extra-activation effects may repeat them.
identity.lore: The old watch carried this blade toward the first light.

effects.description: Deal physical damage to the current enemy.
effects.condition: Item is packed and all activation costs are affordable.

effects.description: Bypass this amount of the current enemy block on an attack.
effects.condition: Item is packed and all activation costs are affordable.

conditions: Both unlocked ingredients are packed and form an orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Consume nothing if requirements fail. If the result cannot fit after consumption, it remains unpacked.
recipes.description: Combine two Dusksteel Blade into one Dawnbringer.

visual.brief: A ceremonial long steel sword with a crown-shaped gold guard, ivory grip and broad spear point. Gold is a material, never an edge-light effect.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; no colored rim lighting or isolated glints.
